extracted.name: Buffalo Ranch Dip
extracted.description: Needed something to dip a potato chip in. And since I only go to the grocery store once a week, time to concoct a game day potion. Let me know how you like it.
ingredient_lines: 1/8 cup heavy cream (or whole milk if that’s all you have)
2 tbs your favorite buffalo sauce (or any hot sauce)
2 tbs ranch dip mix (such as Hidden Valley)
1/2 tsp cayenne (or pepper powder of your desired heat level...I used habanero)
instruction_lines: Mix all ingredients in a small-medium mixing bowl and transfer to serving dish and ENJOY!
